# Harrison

[Island](../codex/places.md#island)

## Appearance

Harrison is a short, fat, and bald man with a round face and prominent blue eyes. His appearance is noted for being particularly neat and snug.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P8](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0008)_

## Personality

A crusty, lonesome, and crabbed old man, Harrison is known for his blunt outspokenness and being hard to please, though he is also an awful kind person who shows outward sympathy. He is a pipe-smoker, a regular churchgoer who subscribes to the salary, and harbors a clear prejudice against marriage. Despising being pitied, he strategically wears a white collar during business transactions so that he appears prosperous enough to prevent others from trying to cheat him.

_Sources: [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P56](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0056), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P76](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0076), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P78](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0078), +3 more_

## History

Before moving to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Harrison was an old bachelor who lived in Scottsford, [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick), having delayed getting married for a long time. His initial encounter with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) was a heated argument after her cow strayed into his oats, but their relationship quickly mended when [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally sold his Jersey cow and came to offer a replacement and a baked cake. Over tea and conversations on his porch, he established a warm friendship with [Anne](../character/anne.md), though he skeptically doubted her plan to teach without whipping students and later refused to donate to her [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) project. He eventually confessed to [Anne](../character/anne.md) that he and his wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), had previously separated over his parrot and her housecleaning habits, a candid conversation that paved the way for Emily's return and their marital reconciliation. After [Anne](../character/anne.md) grew older and pursued creative endeavors, Harrison offered feedback on a short story she wrote. He also continued to act as a neighborly presence in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), bringing letters to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) during Anne's college visits home.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P14](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0014), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P17](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0017), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P21](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0021), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P24](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0024), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P30](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0030), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031), +470 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--harrison.md)

Harrison's relationship with [Anne](../character/anne.md) began on bad terms when he angrily confronted her for letting her cow into his oats, and she insulted his baldness in response. Their dynamic shifted into a good friendship after [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally sold his cow, brought a nut cake as a peace offering, and confessed her mistake. Harrison took the situation in good humor and invited her to tea, leading to regular evening visits where they chat and bond.

- Friend of — good friends who visit and chat in the evening  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028)</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--harrison.md)

Harrison and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) became friendly neighbors after resolving a mix-up where [Anne](../character/anne.md) mistakenly sold his Jersey cow to a buyer. She visited his house with a cake to apologize, and the two bonded over tea. Since then, [Anne](../character/anne.md) frequently visits Harrison on his porch to converse and seek his opinions on local matters, though he remains skeptical of some of her ideas, such as her decision to avoid corporal punishment in teaching.

- Friend of — neighbors who became friends over tea and cake  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P31](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0031)</sub>

### [Emily](../character/emily.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--harrison.md)

[Emily](../character/emily.md) is Harrison's wife, from whom he was previously separated due to conflicts over housecleaning habits and his parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md). After Harrison explained their past estrangement to [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Emily](../character/emily.md) returned home to him. Upon her arrival, she reconciled with Harrison and warmly welcomed [Anne](../character/anne.md) into their home.

- Spouse of — married  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P9](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0009), +1 more</sub>
